title: Vegan French Vegetable Quinoa Bowl
description: A hearty and flavorful quinoa bowl filled with roasted vegetables and a tangy sauce, perfect for a vegan dinner.
instructions: Toss the carrots and sweet potatoes with 1 tbsp of oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
Cook the quinoa according to package instructions.
In a large pot, sauté the macaroni in 1 tbsp of oil until lightly browned.
Add the roasted vegetable broth, thyme, and garlic to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes.
Add the cooked quinoa to the pot and stir to combine.
Toss the green beans with 1 tbsp of oil, salt, and pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast in the oven for 10 minutes.
To assemble the bowls, divide the quinoa mixture among bowls and top with roasted vegetables and green beans.
Drizzle with French red wine vinegar and serve.
